title: Keep the extinguisher in its place
lines: On a busy workday, equipment keeps moving around.
Sometimes the fire extinguisher ends up behind a pile.
So check every day: is it in its assigned spot?
Is it protected from knocks, and easy to see?
In a fire, there's no time to search.
The right spot means a fast, safe response.
Tal's daily tip. Ofek At Tal Cranes.
